aboutGame.title: What Is Golden Sky Festival?
paragraphs: Golden Sky Festival, also styled GoldenSky Festival, is a two-day outdoor country music festival at Discovery Park in Sacramento, California. The 2027 edition runs October 9–10 and brings country, Americana, roots, and crossover acts to a multi-stage riverside site. The event is produced by the team behind Sacramento's Aftershock Festival.

This independent guide covers the full weekend: lineup tracking, tiered passes and RFID wristbands, daily set times, Discovery Park entrances, Cal Expo camping and Park & Ride shuttles, food and drink rules, and practical first-timer planning. Use it to move from the first lineup announcement to a complete festival itinerary.

faq.title: Golden Sky Festival FAQ
faq.description: Answers to the most common questions about the Golden Sky Festival weekend in Sacramento.

items.question: What is Golden Sky Festival?
items.answer: Golden Sky Festival is a two-day outdoor country music festival at Discovery Park in Sacramento, California. The 2027 edition runs October 9–10 and features country, Americana, roots, and crossover acts across multiple stages.

items.question: When is Golden Sky Festival 2027?
items.answer: Golden Sky Festival 2027 takes place Saturday, October 9 and Sunday, October 10, 2027.

items.question: Where is Golden Sky Festival held?
items.answer: Golden Sky Festival is held at Discovery Park in Sacramento, California, where the American River meets the Sacramento River. The site has north and south entrances at Garden Highway and Jibboom Street.

items.question: What do Golden Sky Festival tickets include?
items.answer: Golden Sky Festival passes provide festival admission and arrive as RFID wristbands. Single-day, two-day, VIP, and hotel bundle options are sold separately from camping and parking passes.

items.question: Can I leave and re-enter Golden Sky Festival?
items.answer: Standard Golden Sky Festival passes do not allow re-entry. Camping passes, Country Club SVIP passes, and Admission + Hotel packages booked through Jampack include re-entry during event hours.

items.question: What can I bring to Golden Sky Festival?
items.answer: Bring a clear bag or small clutch, one sealed 20 oz water bottle or an empty plastic bottle, lotion sunscreen, a blanket, and a light layer. Glass, outside alcohol, coolers, drones, selfie sticks, and large bags are prohibited.

items.question: Where can I stay near Golden Sky Festival?
items.answer: Golden Sky Festival camping is available at Cal Expo with car and tent or RV sites. Downtown, Midtown, Old Sacramento, and Natomas offer hotel options within a short drive or rideshare of Discovery Park.
